content: We evaluate three variants of our distilled student models: with only dual training of the teacher and student vocabularies (DualTrain) and with dual training along with down-projection (DualTrain + SharedProjDown) or up-projection (DualTrain + SharedProjUp) of the teacher model parameters. For each of these configurations, we train student models with embedding and hidden dimensions 48, 96 and 192, for 9 total variants, each using a compact 5K-WordPiece vocabulary. Table TABREF14 presents some statistics on these models' sizes: our smallest model contains two orders of magnitude fewer parameters, and requires only 1% floating-point operations when compared to the BERTBASE model.
